category_commentary: Post-quantum from genesis with an algorithm-agile architecture.
tx_signature_commentary: CRYSTALS-Dilithium default with multi-scheme support (Falcon, SPHINCS+).
consensus_commentary: Post-quantum PoS with Dilithium validator signing.
p2p_commentary: Kyber-512 key encapsulation and post-quantum node identity.
onchain_commentary: No elliptic-curve cryptography in on-chain logic.
other_commentary: Algorithms can be hot-swapped without a hard fork.
ec_sunset_commentary: No elliptic curve in the core protocol, so there is nothing to retire.

category_commentary: Lattice-native chain that also accepts EC for EVM compatibility.
tx_signature_commentary: ML-DSA (Dilithium) native; ECDSA also accepted for EVM compatibility.
p2p_commentary: Post-quantum node identity; transport encryption status unconfirmed.
onchain_commentary: QVM verifies ML-DSA signatures natively on-chain.
other_commentary: Multi-language smart-contract support (not a cryptographic feature).
ec_sunset_commentary: Elliptic curve is retained for EVM compatibility with no announced removal timeline.

category_commentary: Hash-based from genesis; Zond upgrade adds an EVM execution layer.
tx_signature_commentary: XMSS (NIST SP 800-208) from genesis; SPHINCS+ planned via Zond.
consensus_commentary: Hash-based proof-of-work (RandomX); Zond proof-of-stake uses post-quantum validator keys.
p2p_commentary: Node identity via XMSS; transport encryption status unconfirmed.
onchain_commentary: Zond EVM verifies post-quantum signatures on testnet, not yet on mainnet.
ec_sunset_commentary: Never used elliptic curve, so there is nothing to retire.

tx_signature_commentary: Lattice-based ring signatures across all privacy levels.
p2p_commentary: Architecture suggests post-quantum transport; not confirmed in docs.
onchain_commentary: No L1 contracts; an EVM-compatible L2 is planned.
ec_sunset_commentary: Never used elliptic curve, so there is nothing to retire.

category_commentary: Post-quantum security-overlay L1; mainnet April 2026, unproven at scale.
consensus_commentary: dPoSec consensus with post-quantum validator identity.
p2p_commentary: Sub-Zero Layer claims post-quantum transport; specifics not documented.
onchain_commentary: Security overlay for other chains; on-chain post-quantum verification claimed.
other_commentary: Novel security layer; recently launched and unproven at scale.
ec_sunset_commentary: No elliptic curve in its own protocol; classical key usage is blocked once post-quantum keys are adopted.

category_commentary: Post-quantum privacy L1, mainnet since Feb 2026; hash-based crypto with no elliptic curve anywhere.
tx_signature_commentary: Hash-based PQC lock scripts; no EC (exact scheme name pending source confirmation).
p2p_commentary: Peer transport is plain TCP/IP with no documented encryption or PQC handshake.
onchain_commentary: On-chain validity verified by zk-STARKs via Triton VM; transparent and hash-based.
other_commentary: Mutator-set privacy (AOCL + SWBF) on hash commitments; a quantum break does not retroactively deanonymize the ledger.
ec_sunset_commentary: No elliptic curve anywhere in the protocol; nothing to retire.

category_commentary: Marketed as post-quantum but the blockchain layer is standard EC Substrate.
tx_signature_commentary: Ed25519/Sr25519 (Substrate standard); no post-quantum transaction signing.
p2p_commentary: Substrate libp2p over elliptic curve; cMix is a separate layer.
onchain_commentary: Standard Substrate; no post-quantum signature verification.
other_commentary: The cMix mixnet uses post-quantum key exchange, a privacy layer only.
ec_sunset_commentary: No plan to migrate the blockchain layer from elliptic curve to post-quantum.
